payload.text:
Executable agents:
Builtin agents
- claude-code (builtin, external-cli:claude): Read-only Claude Code CLI analysis; requires local authentication and trusted user settings/hooks
- claude-code-writer (builtin, external-cli:claude): Explicit file-writing Claude Code CLI mode; requires local authentication and trusted user settings/hooks
- codex-exec (builtin, external-cli:codex): Read-only one-shot analysis through the installed Codex CLI
- codex-exec-writer (builtin, external-cli:codex): Explicit workspace-writing one-shot execution through the installed Codex CLI
- cursor-agent (builtin, external-cli:cursor-agent): Read-only one-shot analysis through the installed Cursor CLI
- cursor-agent-writer (builtin, external-cli:cursor-agent): Explicit workspace-writing one-shot execution through the installed Cursor CLI
- delegate (builtin): Lightweight subagent that inherits the parent model with no default reads
- evidence-auditor (builtin): Independent evidence reviewer for checking whether important research claims are supported by their sources
- oracle (builtin, context: fork, aliases: advisor): High-context decision-consistency oracle that protects inherited state and prevents drift
- researcher (builtin): Autonomous web researcher — searches, evaluates, and synthesizes a focused research brief
- reviewer (builtin): Versatile review specialist for code diffs, plans, proposed solutions, codebase health, and PR/issue validation
- scout (builtin): Fast codebase recon that returns compressed context for handoff
- worker (builtin, context: fresh, aliases: developer, coder, implementer, develop): Implementation agent for normal tasks and approved oracle handoffs
